title: lab-notebook phase 0: SPEC.md + BioEmu fixture graph
close_reason: SPEC.md and BioEmu fixture committed on nb-dev; user reviewed fit notes and approved. Added settled question status and open-question-under-superseded-goal lint warning at review.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/c39f08f2
notes.text: SPEC.md written (plugins/lab-notebook/SPEC.md). Choices beyond the plan: goals also start pending when Claude-authored (otherwise Claude could add a goal to justify an experiment); no supersede command, supersession takes effect when the superseding node is established (so it is gated by confirm); added reject command and rejected status for pending goal/conclusion/decision; hypothesis supported/refuted and question answered require a supported conclusion linked to it; nb predict keeps predictions and tests links in step. Fixture being written by a sub-agent.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/c39f08f2
notes.text: User decisions after reviewing fixture fit notes (2026-10-28): --retro flag for experiments whose predictions were written after results; conclusion confidence, nestable metrics, tags added; post-hoc analysis is a new exploration that 'uses' the result (new edge), not a deviation. Also fixed: links append-only after creation except basis links; lead status 'confirmed' removed; lint warn when a verdict loses its supported conclusion. Fixture revised to 68 nodes. Awaiting user review before phase 1.
